terms.gloss: a furrow; a trench for planting
evidence: Varr. RR 1.29.3: quā arātrum vōmere lacūnam striam facit, sulcus vocātur (Lewis & Short)
Cato Agr. 61.1: sulcō variō nē arēs (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: grandia saepe quibus mandāvimus hordea sulcīs
phrases.english: in the furrows to which we have so often entrusted big grains of barley

phrases.latin: quā arātrum vōmere lacūnam striam facit, sulcus vocātur
phrases.english: where the plough makes a hollow channel with its share, it is called a furrow
